title: IP-SAKTI Sahayak — formulation-aware retrieval study
status: Planned study; no experimental findings included
question: Does source-linked clarification improve supported resolution and reduce incorrect applicability at comparable answer coverage?

coreMethods.name: Dense RAG
coreMethods.question: Can semantic similarity retrieve the evidence this case needs?
coreMethods.change: Semantic retrieval only. No interactive clarification stage.
coreMethods.limit: A relevant passage does not establish that its conditions apply to the case.

coreMethods.name: Hybrid RAG
coreMethods.question: Do exact legal terms and semantic matches complement each other?
coreMethods.change: Replace dense-only retrieval with lexical and semantic retrieval. Hold the generator and evidence budget fixed.
coreMethods.limit: Better retrieval cannot supply facts the user has not provided.

coreMethods.name: Hybrid + clarification
coreMethods.question: Does collecting the missing fact improve a supported, case-specific answer?
coreMethods.change: Add a bounded clarification stage to B2. Unknown answers remain unknown.
coreMethods.limit: Use a complete-facts control; extra information is not evidence of a better language model.

extensions.name: Graph-assisted RAG
extensions.question: Does traversing source relationships help with multi-source questions?
extensions.change: Test graph-assisted evidence selection on cases that require linked provisions. Record the cost and review of graph construction.
extensions.limit: A curated condition graph is not automatically Microsoft GraphRAG. A graph database is storage, not an additional baseline.

extensions.name: Document-tree retrieval
extensions.question: Does keeping a provision with its parent section preserve important context?
extensions.change: Evaluate hierarchy-based retrieval on definition, exception and cross-reference cases. Specify the actual traversal implementation.
extensions.limit: “Vectorless” describes a family, not one algorithm. BM25 is also vectorless; a section browser alone is not a RAG experiment.

extensions.name: Agentic retrieval
extensions.question: Does choosing another search step help enough to justify its cost?
extensions.change: Allow a controller to choose retrieval actions within a fixed call and token budget; compare it with a fixed workflow.
extensions.limit: Agentic control can use dense, hybrid or graph retrieval. Count every model call and include failed or exhausted runs.

controls: Same evidence-token budget and answer prompt
No test answers or hidden facts in the retrieval index
laterExperiments: Generic versus source-linked clarification at the same turn budget
Document hierarchy for definitions and exceptions
